commits.subject: fix(extract): extract .deb members into the result directories

contributions.description: fix(extract): extract .deb members into their result directories — the deb arm pre-created control/ and data/ then recursed with extract ../control.tar.*, so member tarballs landed double-nested (pkg/control/control/...) whenever control.tar had 2+ members, and data/ survived only when data.tar had a single top-level entry. Extract each member directly with tar -C into the prepared dirs reusing the plugin's per-compression chains; add .deb regression tests in default/target/remove modes.
contributions.notes: AI-assisted (disclosed in PR body per ohmyzsh CONTRIBUTING); the bug had no upstream issue, issue #14200 filed by this run and linked via Fixes; red/green proof on master; fixture matrix gz/xz/zst/bz2 locally.
